payload.title: Working with GeoSeries
payload.summary: This notebook introduces the GeoSeries class, an extension of the Series class in the Pyleoclim library, designed to handle geoscientific time series with additional metadata such as geolocation. It demonstrates how to load data using the LiPD library, instantiate GeoSeries objects, and utilize their enhanced functionalities. The notebook also covers the creation and manipulation of MultipleGeoSeries objects, which bundle multiple GeoSeries for collective analysis. Mapping techniques are showcased to visualize geospatial data, focusing on specific regions and identifying neighboring records.
goals: Introduce the GeoSeries class and its functionalities.
Demonstrate data loading and manipulation using LiPD and Pyleoclim.
Showcase mapping techniques for geospatial data visualization.
